author: Intel
description:
In this episode, James Boyd, Principal Engineer at Intel, joins host Jerry Bryant to discuss Intel® Total Storage Encryption (Intel® TSE).

Intel® TSE delivers near-native NVMe performance with hardware-based encryption, stronger key protection, and up to 75% lower CPU overhead, resulting in longer battery life. It provides security that is fast, efficient, and invisible to users.

Available today on Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 3 processors with Intel vPro®.
